title: Turing-like tests for language and vision demonstrate a narrowing gap between humans and AI
title_zh: 图灵测试式评估语言与视觉：人类与AI的差距日益缩小
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in daily life, ascertaining whether an agent is human is critical. Here we systematically benchmark AI’s ability to imitate humans in three language tasks (image captioning, word association and conversation) and three vision tasks (colour estimation, object detection and attention prediction), collecting data from n = 636 humans and 37 AI agents. We also conducted 72,191 Turing-like tests with 1,916 human judges and 10 AI judges. Current AIs are approaching the ability to convincingly impersonate humans and deceive human judges in both language and vision. Even simple AI judges outperformed humans in distinguishing AI from human responses. Imitation ability showed minimal correlation with conventional AI performance metrics, suggesting that passing as human is an important independent evaluation criterion. The large-scale Turing-like datasets and metrics introduced here offer valuable benchmarks for assessing human-likeness in AI and highlight the importance of rigorous, quantitative imitation tests for AI development. Zhang et al. systematically compare humans and AI across three language and three vision tasks.
abstract_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）在日常生活中日益普及，判断一个代理是否为人类至关重要。在此，我们系统评估AI在三项语言任务（图像描述、词联想和对话）和三项视觉任务（颜色估计、目标检测和注意力预测）中模仿人类的能力，收集了636名人类和37个AI代理的数据。我们还进行了72,191次图灵测试，招募了1,916名人类评审员和10名AI评审员。目前的AI正逐渐具备令人信服地冒充人类并欺骗人类评审员的能力，涉及语言和视觉任务。即使是简单的AI评审员也在区分AI与人类回答方面优于人类。模仿能力与传统AI性能指标相关性极低，这表明通过冒充人类进行评估是一项重要的独立评估标准。所引入的大规模图灵测试数据集和指标为评估AI的类人特性提供了有价值的基准，并强调了在AI开发中进行严谨、定量模仿测试的重要性。Zhang等人系统比较了人类和AI在三项语言和三项视觉任务上的表现。
